tools.name: register_job
tools.description: Register a scheduled job with an outcome contract (file / URL / record, present + non-empty + fresh, optional hash/marker — or a chain contract whose stages' artifacts are the next stage's required input). Args: job_id, contract, stall_budget_s?, due_in_s?, alert via account webhook.

tools.name: start_run
tools.description: Start a run for a job. Args: job_id.

tools.name: checkpoint
tools.description: Report run progress — the watchdog watches progress checkpoints against the job's own wall-clock budget, never process existence. Args: run_id, note?.

tools.name: complete_run
tools.description: Claim completion; the watchdog verifies the declared artifact itself (the claim is never trusted) and issues a signed, hash-chained verdict receipt. Metered check ($0.002 after the one-time 100-check trial / plan rules). Args: run_id, claimed?.

tools.name: verify_now
tools.description: Spot-verify a job's artifact now (independent fetch/hash/read-back by the watchdog). Metered check ($0.002 after trial / plan rules). Args: job_id.

tools.name: watchdog_tick
tools.description: Run the watchdog sweep: STALLED for active runs with no progress checkpoint inside the job's wall-clock budget, MISSED once per due window with no verified run. Not metered.

tools.name: last_verified_success
tools.description: When was this job's last VERIFIED success, and how old is it? Args: job_id.

tools.name: list_verdicts
tools.description: List this operator's signed verdict receipts + receipt-chain re-verification result.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: complete_run · Private data: register_job · Public sink: register_job · Destructive: start_run, checkpoint, complete_run, watchdog_tick.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: complete_run · Private data: register_job · Public sink: register_job · Destructive: start_run, checkpoint, complete_run, watchdog_tick

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
